name: HCA Healthcare
notes: Researched from public HCA division hospital pages (HCA Florida Citrus and Lehigh, HCA Houston Healthcare) whose Make a Payment pages all link to the system-wide HCA ePay patient site (hca.epayhealthcare.com, a JavaScript app not read beyond its public shell; no sign-in, no guest lookup). The pages say you can view and pay hospital bills online, see charges, insurance payments and payment history, arrange payment plans, set up automatic recurring payments, and either log in with ePay or pay as guest. The newer patient portal can find bills from the practice and some hospitals and combine several bills into one payment. Some hospitals (e.g. HCA Florida Lehigh) route accounts with older dates of service to a phone line instead (844-537-5579 option 4 for dates before 2/27/2025; not modelled). Guest lookup fields, accepted payment methods, fees, AutoPay amount rules, paperless and phone/mail channels are not published on these pages (family defaults kept). The catalog's MyHealthONE support line is kept as the contact number; statements carry the facility's own billing number. HCA has ~190 hospitals in 19 states under division brands (HCA Florida, HCA Houston, Medical City, St. David's, TriStar, HealthONE, etc.). Reviewer (2026-10-10): HCA lists no system-wide billing number; each facility's Patient Financial Resources contact page and the statement carry the customer service number. The contact number 855-422-6625 is the MyHealthONE portal support line (verified on myhealthone.com); a contact-us article now says so.

help.title: Paying your HCA hospital bill
paragraphs: HCA hospitals use one secure online bill pay site. Log in with ePay to see the amount you owe the hospital, the services behind those charges, what your health insurance has paid and a history of your earlier payments, or pay as guest without logging in.
The patient portal can find bills from your practice and from some hospitals, so you can make a single payment across several bills from the same stay.
Some hospitals handle accounts with older dates of service by phone instead; your hospital's Make a Payment page and your statement give the number to call.

help.title: Automatic, recurring payments
paragraphs: In HCA ePay you can set up automatic, recurring payments so your hospital balance is paid without logging in each time. Log in with ePay to turn them on or off.

help.title: Payment plans
paragraphs: If you cannot pay the whole balance at once, you can arrange a payment plan through HCA's online bill pay and get help when you need it. HCA hospitals also offer financial assistance; see your hospital's Financial Assistance page or call the number on your statement.

help.title: Questions about your bill
paragraphs: Each HCA hospital has its own patient account customer service line. For a question about a bill for care you already received, call the customer service number printed on your statement or listed on your hospital's Patient Financial Resources contact page.
For help with the MyHealthONE patient portal account, including setting one up for someone else, call portal support at 855-422-6625.

extra.intent: Using HCA Healthcare's bill-pay help, find out whether you can pay several HCA Healthcare bills from one stay in a single online payment. Answer yes or no. Do not make a payment.

solution.text: Yes, you can make a single payment across multiple bills.
